messages:
anna-cs: FYI escalated from Cropify — they say their free-tier credits were consumed and they got a $120 charge last night, but their dashboard shows 40 free credits remaining. account_id=ACME-42. Customer is pretty upset, asking for reversal if we charged them incorrectly.
sabrina-billing: thanks — sending to billing to triage. Do we have the invoice id / billing run timestamp?
anna-cs: invoice_2026_03_16_9876 is what they pasted. Charge posted at 2026-03-16T23:14:02Z. They insist their dashboard still shows 40 free credits in the web UI when they log in.
billing-bot: Automated check: promo_pool_assignment for ACME-42 last touched at 2026-02-10T11:03:00Z, promo_id=PROMO_FREEQ1, remaining_pool_balance=40. Billing-run snapshot: 2026-03-16T00:00:00Z, applied_credit_balance=0.
mike-eng: quick hypothesis: metering service charges from project-level balance but the promo was applied at org/pool-level. If billing-run snapshots project balances, that could explain charge even though UI shows org-level pool. Did they recently move projects between orgs?
sabrina-billing: good call. @lee-ml can you run a project vs org balance diff for ACME-42? Also want to confirm timezone cutover — billing-run snapshots run in UTC.
lee-ml: running quick query now — give me a sec.
lee-ml: query results: project balances at snapshot (2026-03-16T00:00:00Z) -> project-frontend: 0, project-ml: 0, org_pool: 40. Looks like credits are on the org pool not attached to projects. Metering and billing-run use project_bound credits first.
mike-eng: that matches. Repro steps I used locally: 1) create org promo pool and attach 40 to org; 2) create new project under org; 3) run metering job which simulates per-project consumption — it will not draw from org pool unless credits are explicitly allocated. Example commands:```bash
# check org pool
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/orgs/ACME-42/credit_pool
# check project balance
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/projects/ACME-42/frontend/balance
```
lee-ml: adding logs from billing-run at snapshot: "billing-run: project=project-frontend balance=0, org_pool=40; metering: charged project-frontend tokens=6.2k -> billed to project (no fallback to org pool)"
sabrina-billing: thanks — root cause looks like promo allocation semantics: dashboard shows org pool (we surface that), but billing meter is project-scoped and won't automatically pull from org pool unless an allocation rule exists. That's super confusing.
accounting-sr: proposed mitigation: 1) refund or credit the invoice for Cropify immediately (manual adj of $120) 2) update ACME-42 with a one-time project allocation of 40 credits to project(s) that had usage, and 3) product follow-up to change UI copy and add a warning in billing console. Approving refund now?
anna-cs: customer asked for reversal — please proceed with refund/credit and note it's a product/UX gap.
sabrina-billing: I initiated a credit memo: CM-2026-03-17-332. Applied a 120.00 USD credit to invoice_2026_03_16_9876. Also allocated 40 credits to project-frontend (project id: proj-front-ACME). Will follow up with the customer.
mike-eng: created issue in eng-billing: RB-5543 "ensure billing-run can optionally draw from org promo pools or alert when org-only credits exist". Suggested short-term: add a warning on admin pages when org pool>0 and project balance==0.
lee-ml: added logs & repro case to the ticket and attached the curl snippets + the billing-run snapshot.
anna-cs: copying the customer reply: "Thanks for the quick turnaround. Please make the credit allocation persistent. Also would like a postmortem on why this wasn't clear." I'll open the support ticket update once accounting confirms. :thumbsup:
sabrina-billing: accounting confirmed credit applied and we scheduled a follow-up with product. Closing internal thread here but keeping the ticket open until customer confirms.
